description: Implementation of Gradium's real-time speech-to-text service using WebSocket API, including connection management, audio processing, and transcription handling.

classes.name: GradiumSTTService
classes.description: A class implementing real-time speech-to-text using Gradium's WebSocket API, managing connection, audio streaming, and transcription processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GradiumSTTService with API credentials, endpoint, and optional JSON config.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech-to-text process, establishing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech-to-text process and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing speech-to-text processing and disconnects.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, streams them over WebSocket, and yields processing frames.

methods.name: _trace_transcription
methods.description: Records transcription events for tracing purposes.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and manages setup.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup, including headers and initial handshake.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Terminates WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket object or raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: _process_messages
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages and dispatches based on message type.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages, reconnecting if disconnected.

methods.name: _process_response
methods.description: Handles different message types from WebSocket, such as text, end_of_stream, and error.

methods.name: _handle_end_of_stream
methods.description: Handles end of stream message from server.

methods.name: _handle_text
methods.description: Processes transcription text and pushes transcription frame.
